correctness.rationale: Leibniz applied to xyx kills scalar parts; derivations are 12-parameter, with block matrix [A,0;B,A⊗I+I⊗A]. Complete rank table for A is obtained by eigenvalue/Jordan analysis in all characteristics. The quotient-space rank-count lemma gives each B multiplicity as q^(2l+ta) times Gaussian coefficients and |GL_j|; sums to q^12. The standalone actual verifier computes the full Leibniz linear system (rank 37 in 49 unknowns) for q=2,3 and independently enumerates all 4096 and 531441 operator ranks plus extension-field q=4 samples. Finite enumerations are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Complete operator-rank multiplicities are a natural invariant of the smallest free two-loop unital algebra retaining xy and yx separately. They classify all seven possible ranks in odd characteristic, prove a sharp maximum of four in characteristic two, and distinguish the tensor-square action from the symmetric-square action in the commutative quotient. This is not obtained from a routine derivation-space dimension count.
